summary: F1 witnessed. The four ScanToPdf and MyDownloads carriers' Jenkinsfiles run `build job:` on ScanToPdf, MyDownloads and Webathome, and each of those pins into ScantopdfDeploy, MediaDeploy or WebathomeOrgDeploy, whose -prd Applications auto-sync. Jenkins records upstream causes from the carriers. The four moved from P11 to P12a–b, with no batch sharing a deploy repo, and the waits are recomputed with the downstream builds: P11 ~30, P12a ~40, P12b ~65. The ledger, the P10 done-record and close-out N4 are updated in AnsibleSpecs 44a3336. The Ansible diff is unchanged (b92d01a), and the architecture gate is green.
